intent.raw: Implement the approved Arcanum add-on work-pack one explicitly selected SWU at a time.
intent.objective: Preserve Bootstrap, ResonantOS, Augmentor, execution, state, artifact, memory, readiness, promotion, and release owners while requiring complete exact receipt sets at every W0-W4 boundary.
intent.operator_sentence: Resolve governance and compatibility first; select one exact SWU per Task Session; close it; re-enter selection; and cross a wave only through its complete receipt-set join.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The default implementation route is sequential and admits exactly one explicitly selected SWU per Task Session.
subagent_strategy.explanation: No parallel worker route is authorized. The uninstall and rollback nodes are dependency siblings over isolated snapshots, not permission for concurrent workers. Any later delegated execution requires its own validated and confirmed dispatch.

gates.condition: Governing issue, Project 2 item, owners, retention disposition, current source binding, and the one selected SWU are explicit.
Compatibility checks are no-write; BOOT-002 requires separate exact approval; product work cannot imply Bootstrap mutation.
Every exact SWU ends after one owner receipt and complete closeout sync; execution returns to explicit operator selection before any successor.
W0-COMPLETE binds passing GOV-001 and BOOT-001 receipts.
W1-COMPLETE binds CATALOG, STATUS, PROPOSAL, PROPOSAL-UI, and current L0-DECISION receipts; W2 additionally requires disposition continue.
W2-COMPLETE binds APPROVAL, RUN, and RUN-UI receipts.
W3-COMPLETE binds BOOT-002, post-refresh compatibility, both adapters, CLARIFY, ARTIFACT-READ, ATTACH, CONSUME, and INTAKE receipts.
W4-COMPLETE binds DEGRADE, DISABLE, isolated UNINSTALL and ROLLBACK branches, their typed lifecycle join, SECURITY, and literal BROWSER receipts.
VERIFY-001 consumes W0-COMPLETE through W4-COMPLETE and proves deterministic, security, repository, and live-browser evidence against the exact candidate.
Verification routes only readiness; promotion and release remain separate owner decisions.

boundaries.contract: Product consumes admitted redacted compatibility receipts and never writes Bootstrap-managed generated packages.
Every exact SWU returns its named source-bound receipt, completes closeout sync, and re-enters explicit selection; generic layer receipts are forbidden.
Only exact named wave-complete receipts admit a later wave; VERIFY-001 must consume the complete W4 bundle.
Verification may inform readiness but cannot promote or release.

authority.execution: stable public Arcanum owner operation through ResonantOS mediation
authority.evidence: operation and validation owners return separate exact receipts

state_namespaces.write_policy: explicit intake request; no trusted write

promotion_splits.rule: acceptance owner decides; verification cannot self-admit
promotion owner independently admits the exact candidate
release owner applies release-specific policy and packaging

promotion_guardrails: Plan evidence is not implementation evidence.
A generated package is not an installed or granted product add-on.
Augmentor projection is not approval or execution truth.
Readiness, promotion, and release are independent owner decisions.
